properties.description: crates/reflow2-core/tests/a_write_unit_is_all_or_nothing.rs, on the in-memory backend and again under the workspace's rocksdb+fulltext build: nesting through the public bulk forms (an inner refusal, an inner commit, a check_only inside a batch), detect_gaps inside a batch against a control outside one, and the unit API (discard, commit, empty). The nesting and derived-scan cases were observed FAILING on main. Engine-level savepoint and write-generation tests sit in foundation/store/engine/tests.rs, and the full-text publish and re-derive tests in engine/fulltext_tests.rs.
properties.name: A write unit is all or nothing however it is nested: an inner batch never commits the outer one, a derived scan inside a batch sees its writes, a discarded unit leaves the store as it was
